prompt.generated_prompt_string: In a soft beige studio, construct a 3x3 finely edited photo grid of the same adult woman. She wears a dark navy lightweight shirt and off-white trousers, and is barefoot in the seated panel to preserve raw natural texture. Use a large-area soft light from the front right, a silver reflector on the left, and a subtle top rim light. Create nine lens compositions: 85mm f/1.8 extreme lip close-up; eye close-up looking toward a mirror; black-and-white chin-support portrait; partially obscured portrait; hand-over-face close-up; hair covering the eye; hand touching chin detail; half-body side sitting posture; and cinematic side profile with a single tear. Keep identity, wardrobe, studio, skin texture, and color grade consistent across all panels.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, text, watermark, logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed, duplicated hands, mismatched panel identity
